## Content

A trial of registering only migration paths for ordinary RefreshDatabase tests preserved full core/drive/media counts, but did not improve measured duration. The trial was removed byte-exactly from core/Spatie and selectively from already-changed Drive/Media TestCases. FixtureTestCase keeps its required fixture-owned schema lifecycle. P1 selects its actual PostgreSQL behavior checks; full package suites are separate. Interrupted broad P1 attempts have no verdict and are not counted.
